messages:
ellen: FYI seeing a sustained uptick in us-west control-plane 5xxs. pausing tonight's 21:00 UTC release until we confirm. :warning:
deploybot: note: release 'release/2026.03.21' -> PAUSED by incident-detect. canary job canary-7 terminated. requeue cleared.
sam: copy. do we need an immediate rollback for the canary fleet or just stop new rollouts?
elllen: (typo) ellen: stop new rollouts only for now. canary VMs already stopped; no mass rollback yet. we need to decide whether to pin the previous stable before rescheduling.
nora: recommend pin. the DB migration in the release is gated but still risky if we retry too soon. suggest pin to v2026.03.14 and add a migration-gate note.
ops-oncall: I restarted control-plane replica at +5m. errors tapered after ~12m but saw intermittent 503s to internal probes. want a 30m quiet window before any new canaries.
maria: if we're waiting 30m let's also update release notes and change the customer-facing schedule. I can draft the comms blurb.
sam: checklist proposal: 1) pin previous stable, 2) observe 30m quiet, 3) update changelog/release notes, 4) ops ack, 5) requeue via deploybot. owner?
nora: assigning pin to me. running: `rbctl pin release/2026.03.14 --reason "us-west control-plane incident hold"` will comment in the ticket.
elllen: (typo) ellen: @deploybot can you suggest next available windows given team policy? pref late-night UTC 02:00-04:00.
deploybot: suggested windows for team 'api': ["2026-03-22T02:00:00Z", "2026-03-22T03:00:00Z", "2026-03-23T02:00:00Z"]. default canary fraction=10%, health_window=15m, require health >=99.5%. auto-fallback to pinned version on regression.
ops-oncall: +1 for 02:00 slot. I'll lower alert thresholds for the next 2h and watch ingress tails.
maria: drafting release-note: "Release deferred due to transient control-plane errors in us-west. Requeue planned; will post final slot." will ping legal/comms if needed.
sam: nora please confirm when pin is complete and paste the ticket comment.
nora: pin complete. ticket comment: "pinned to v2026.03.14 due to us-west control-plane incident. will re-evaluate before reschedule."
ops-oncall: observed quiet period met at +31m. system metrics stable. ready for requeue.
sam: @deploybot please schedule the first suggested 02:00 slot and keep canary fraction 10% with automatic rollback on regression.
deploybot: acknowledged. scheduled requeue: 2026-03-22T02:00:00Z. canary policy applied: fraction=0.10, health_window=15m, rollback_on=regression. notification to #eng-releases will post 30m before slot.
elllen: (typo) ellen: thanks everyone. I'll create a short incident note in #incidents with timeline and attach deploybot schedule. propose a quick retro tomorrow to tighten pre-flight control-plane checks. :thumbsup:
sam: thanks all  closing thread once deploybot posts the scheduled message.
deploybot: scheduled notification posted to #eng-releases at 2026-03-22T01:30:00Z with canary PID and rollback hooks."
